newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,129 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,129 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,129 contracts compared with 841 overnight Wednesday.
There were 102 wheat, 163 corn, 704 soybean, 56 soymeal, 37 soyoil, 20 corn calls, 22 corn puts, four soybean calls and 21 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent higher to 1/2 lower, corn was 1/4 to 1-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were 3-1/2 to nine cents higher.
